resources.string: Inverts the colors of everything below. Use the layer mask to limit it.
Affects all layers below. Add a layer mask (Layers) to limit it to an area, or clip it to one layer.
Tap a sticker to add it as a layer, then move, scale or rotate it.
One finger uses the tool, two fingers zoom and move. Hold still with Twirl, Pucker or Bloat to keep going. Freeze protects an area.
Tap the area to copy from
Paint to copy from the source (follows your strokes)
Set the source first: tap Set source, then tap the area to copy from.
Source set. Now paint where you want the copy.
Draw around the area to fix with the Lasso (or use a selection), then drag it onto a clean area: it is filled with that texture and blended in.
Drag from the selection to a clean area of the image.
Drag further: from the selected area to the area to copy.
Draw the area to fix first (Lasso).
These tools work on an image layer. Select a photo layer or add an empty layer.
The tool could not be applied.
One finger paints, two fingers zoom and move. Each stroke can be undone.
No face found in this layer. Faces must be clear and at least about 1/12 of the image.

Pick the smallest radius where Low shows no pores or fine detail (skin: about 4–10 px). Two layers are added: Low (fix uneven color with Tools > Blur, Smudge or Clone Stamp) and High in Linear Light (remove blemishes with Clone or Patch without changing color). The original layer is hidden.
Frequency separation ready: High (texture) is selected
Tap the image to fill the area of similar colour with the chosen colour (Photoshop\'s Paint Bucket). With a selection, only the selection is filled.
Tap the image to take its colour.
Tap inside the layer to take its colour.
Nothing to fill there (outside the selection or the layer).
Draw around the area to fix with one finger.

Erases the layer\'s pixels to transparency (use a layer mask to hide without erasing).
Drag on the image: from the first colour to the second. Fills the area of similar colour where you start (or the selection).
Drag further to draw the gradient.
Tap the image to fill the area of similar colour with the pattern (or the selection).
Paint over flyaway hair and fur (from inside the subject outward): those areas are matted strand by strand.
Paint to add to the selection.
Paint to remove from the selection.

Paint over a blemish, spot or small object: when you lift your finger it is replaced by texture from the best matching area around it, with the colour blended in.
No suitable area around to heal from. Try a smaller stroke.

AI Colorize turns black-and-white photos into colour on your phone. It needs a one-time download of its model; after that it works offline.
Download failed. Check the connection and try again (it resumes where it stopped).
The colours are guessed from the scene: skies, plants and skin are usually right; clothes and objects may need touching up. The result goes to a new layer.
